scope: 11 supers; DDC product data only; no game/build/code writes
cooldown_basis: DDC Base Cooldown, not actual passively charged time under arbitrary Super Stat, kill gains, or activity scalars. Do not multiply by Chunk Scalar.
ticks_conversion: Seconds * 20 only; attack energy drain and field/cast lifecycles are separate.
damage_policy: Exact source descriptions retained for evidence. Destiny HP/damage/metres and Minecraft HP/damage/blocks are NOT treated as equivalent.

entries.name: Ward of Dawn
entries.condition_summary: persistent dome 30s; Super Stat up to 40s at 200; core pickup after 3s, twice per cast; projectile exceptions and construct/core health are separate mechanics

exact_cells.text:
General Super Information
Damage Resistance while in Cast Animation: ?% [26.5%]
Grants 1 Grenade Ability Charge and creates 3 Orbs of Power that each grant 2.3% Super Energy on Super Cast.

Ward of Dawn:
Projects a 8,000 Construct HP Protective Dome with 75??% NEEDS TESTING Damage Resistance against Combatants alongside an internal core with 200 HP.
Guardians deal 50% increased damage to the Protective Dome itself. Ability Damage scales uniquely.
Protective Dome covers an 8 meter radius centered around its internal core for 30 seconds. Destroying the core destroys the Ward of Dawn.
The Ward of Dawn prevents all projectiles from entering or leaving the dome unless an enemy is within it.
While a Combatant is inside the dome: The caster and their allies are able to shoot through the dome.
Deploying or redeploying the Ward of Dawn pulls Combatants within 15 meters inwards.
Super Stat scales its duration by up to +10 seconds at 200 Super Stat.

While inside the Ward of Dawn Dome:
Ward of Dawn Caster receives +50% Increased Melee Damage. Scoring a Melee Kill as the Caster generates an Orb of Power up to 5 times per Super cast.
Enemies are constantly weakened. Combatants up to ? meters away are taunted towards Guardians inside the dome.
Armor of Light | Constantly generates 15 Void Overshield/s and grants 40% [?%] Damage Resist, +50 Handling, and +50 Reload Speed.
Weapons of Light | 25% Damage Increase that lingers for 0.3 seconds. Helm of Saint-14 allows it to linger for 15 seconds.

Redeployement:
The Ward of Dawn Core can be picked up by the caster after 3 seconds of being deployed, up to twice per cast. Swirling orbs represent the amount of pickups left.
While picked up: Remaining Ward of Dawn duration is decreased by 1 second every (77 / Armor of Light seconds left on pickup).
The Core can be thrown to redeploy by the caster up to 2 times per cast.

entries.name: Well of Radiance
entries.condition_summary: persistent well 30s; Super Stat up to 40s at 200; leaving aura gives Radiant 8+4s; caster weapon damage counts as Super Ability Damage

exact_cells.text:
Places down a Well of Radiance for 30 seconds, restoring 300HP to the caster, dealing up to 150 damage, and inflicting 40+20 Scorch to enemies within 8.5 metres.
Creates 3 Orbs of Power, each granting 3.6% Super Energy.
Super Duration scales with Super Stat, up to 40 seconds at 200 Super.

Well of Radiance:
Construct with 800 HP. Can be frozen and damaged by Stasis Shatter
Projects an aura that buffs the caster and allies within 6 metres. Leaving the aura grants Radiant for 8+4 seconds.
Combatants deal 0.25x Damage against the Well of Radiance.

For Guardians inside the Well of Radiance:
25% Increased Weapon Damage, 20% Damage Resist against Combatants (10% vs Boss Combatants), immunity to Stasis Effects, and restores 50HP/s.
Guardians receive 50% Damage Resist against Special and Power Weapons, as well as Abilities. Primary Weapons remain at 40% Damage Resist.
Removes any active Restoration effect. 
Weapon Damage dealt by the Caster is counted as Super Ability Damage. Caster can spawn up to 5 Orbs from scoring kills within the Well.
